paite: Himahleh keimah lam thu ah zaw hiai ka na tum tintenta ahi, lungkhamna dia na kiang ua hong nawnta lou ding in.
english: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

paite: Ke'n ka hon hihlungkhamleh ka hihlungkhampen mah lou in kua'n ahia kei hon hihkipak ding?
english: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

paite: Huchi in huai mahmah ka gelh ahi, huchi lou in zaw ka hong in ka kipahna dingte lak ah lungkhamna ka mu zaw kha ding a; ka kipahna zaw na vek ua kipahna ahih ka hon gintaksak chiat ngal hi.
english: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

paite: Khitui tampi ke kawm a lungtang a haksa leh lauthawng pipi a ka gelh ahi; hihlungkham a na omna ding uh ahi kei a, na tung ua itna thupizaw sem ka nei chih na theih zawkna ding uh ahi.
english: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh in mite ahihlungkhamleh keimah kia hon hihlungkham ahi kei a, uanggen lua bel hilou in, na vek ua hon hihlungkham chiat ahi zaw hi.
heading: Thil Hihkhial Kisik Ngaihdamna
english: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

paite: Huchibang mi a ding in gawtna na piak tak uh akihun ahi.
english: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

paite: Huchi in na ngaidam un na khamuan zawta ding uh ahi, huchi lou in zaw bangchi chi hiam in mi huchibang alungkham luatna in avalhzou kha ding.
english: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

paite: Huaiziak in amah na itna uh hihkip ding in ka hon ngen hi.
english: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

paite: Hiai ziak mah in leng ka gelh ahi, bang peuhmah thu na man uleh, na man louh uh theihchetna ding in.
english: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

paite: Bang lam peuh a mi na ngaihdam uh ke'n leng ka ngaidam hi; ke'n ka ngaihdam khitsa, bangpeuh ka na ngaihdam takleh noumau ziak in Khrist ah ka ngaidamta ahi.
english: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

paite: Huchi lou in zaw Setan in hunlem ala kha ding hi; atup lah i haih ngal kei ua.
english: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

paite: Huan Khrist tanchinhoih gen ding a Troas ka tun in, Toupa ah kongkhak honsak in ka om hi.
heading: Tanchinhoih Gimnamtui
english: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

paite: Himahleh ka unaupa Titas ka muh louh ziak in ka khalam ah zaw tawldamna himhim ka nei tuan kei, huchi in amaute kampha in ka khen a, ka pawt a, Masidonia gam ah ka paita hi.
english: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

paite: Himahleh Khrist vualzohna a hon pi zelpa leh koute a mun chih a amah theihna gimnamtui theisakpa Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
english: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

paite: Hotdam a omlelte leh mangthang lellelte ah Pathian a ding in Khrist gimnamtui ka hi uhi.
english: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

paite: Pawl khatte a ding in sihna lak ah sihna ding gimnam ka hi ua, pawl khatte ding in hinna lak a hinna ding in gimnam ka hi uh. Hiai bangte a ding in kua ahia chingzou ding?
english: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

paite: Mi tampi in Pathian thu mite khem a sumsinna a azat bang un kou zaw ka zang kei uhi. Pathian sawltak hi zaw in, chihtaktak in Pathian mitmuh in Khrist ah thu ka gen zel uhi.
english: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.
